general news.headline: Live: Dipke, Team CJP taken to undisclosed location after detention inside planeCJP Delhi Protest Live Updates: If you're just joining us, let's catch you up. Never-before-seen scenes played out at Delhi airport as Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) founder Abhijeet Dipke and his co-convenors were detained from inside their plane minutes after it landed. CJP and the All India Students' Association (AISA) have called on supporters to gather at Jantar Mantar to protest against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over allegations of voter list manipulation. With memories of the July 20 chaos and police action — during the paper leak protests that led to the resignation of Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan — still fresh, sweeping curbs have kicked in, turning Delhi into a veritable fortress. Over 20,000 police and Central Armed Police Forces personnel have been deployed across the capital, while more than 600 people with criminal antecedents have been taken into custody. With no permission granted for the protest, police are on high alert amid fears of large-scale mobilisation. Around 150 protesters who gathered at Connaught Place, a stone's throw from Jantar Mantar, have also been detained. So, will the government manage to clamp down on the stir, or will CJP channel the stubbornness and indestructibility of its namesake to pull off Jantar Mantar 2.0? Devika Bhattacharya will bring you the latest updates throughout the day, with help from a battery of reporters on the ground.

Watch: CJP leaders' dramatic detention inside flight, Dipke vlogs from aircraftCockroach Janta Party (CJP) founder Abhijeet Dipke and fellow leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka were detained by the Delhi Police minutes after their flight landed in Delhi on Saturday. The trio were taken into custody from inside an Air India aircraft shortly after its arrival at the Indira Gandhi International Airport. This came ahead of the CJP's proposed Jantar Mantar 2.0 protest, planned for later in the day. While he was being detained, Dipke entered into a brief verbal confrontation with police personnel. "Hum arrest hone ke liye hi aayein hain (We have come to get arrested only)," he was heard saying. "I am not afraid of you guys," the CJP founder said further. One of the multiple videos that surfaced from the video was apparently recorded by Dipke himself. The clip showed the cops approaching his seat.
